_readme: Single source of truth for every setting in this RAG pipeline. Edit values here, then run 'python run_pipeline.py --config config.json' (or the other run_*.py scripts, once loaded via config_loader.py). Every '_about' key is just documentation and is ignored by the loader.

pipeline._about: Top-level chunking pipeline: reads .md files, writes chunk JSON files.

preprocessor._about: Cleans raw markdown before splitting (image handling, TOC tables, footnotes, decoration).

structure_splitter._about: Splits markdown into sections using header levels before semantic chunking.

semantic_chunker._about: Splits each section into chunks based on embedding-similarity breakpoints. Uses a local Ollama model for embeddings.
semantic_chunker.embedding_model_note: Ollama model tag. Lighter options: qwen3-embedding:4b, qwen3-embedding:0.6b. Must be pulled first: ollama pull qwen3-embedding:8b
semantic_chunker.tokenizer_hf_id_note: HuggingFace repo id used ONLY to fetch a tokenizer for accurate token counts. Falls back to word-count heuristic automatically if unavailable.
semantic_chunker.chars_note: Legacy character-based limits, only used when use_token_based_sizing is false.

llm_chunk_refiner._about: OPTIONAL post-chunking pass: asks a local LLM whether adjacent chunks should be merged so an answer isn't orphaned across a chunk boundary. Off by default; roughly doubles chunking time on CPU when enabled.

table_normalizer._about: Converts HTML tables into natural-language prose before embedding.

contextual_enricher._about: Prepends a situating blurb to each chunk (breadcrumb/filename, or an LLM-written summary) so isolated fragments keep their document context. This is 'Contextual Retrieval'.

embed_text._about: The embedding model's instruction-prefix contract. Same values used on both the storage (chunking) side and the query (retrieval) side, so they can never drift apart.
embed_text.query_prefix:
Instruct: Given a search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query
Query:

metadata._about: Controls which metadata fields get attached to every chunk.

embed_generator._about: Turns embed_text strings into vectors via Ollama. Used by run_ingestion.py.

chroma_ingestion._about: Writes embedded chunks into a local persistent ChromaDB collection. Used by run_ingestion.py.

bm25_index._about: Keyword/exact-term search index, complements dense vector search for domain-specific abbreviations. Used by run_bm25_index.py.

hybrid_retriever._about: Combines dense (ChromaDB) + sparse (BM25) search via Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Used by run_query.py / run_answer.py.

reranker._about: OPTIONAL cross-encoder precision pass on the hybrid retriever's top candidates. Needs 'pip install sentence-transformers' + a GPU with free VRAM. Enable with --rerank on run_query.py / run_answer.py.
reranker.model_name_note: Lighter alternative if VRAM is tight: Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B
reranker.task_instruction: Given a search query, determine whether this document contains information that answers the query.

context_builder._about: Formats retrieved chunks into the context block the answer-generation LLM reads.

llm_client._about: Wraps Ollama for offline answer generation. Used by run_answer.py.

ragas_evaluator._about: Measures whether retrieval + generation are actually working, using RAGAS metrics. Fully offline (Ollama for judge LLM + embeddings, never OpenAI). Used by run_evaluation.py.
